"""Create a Team Meeting calendar event for next Wednesday at 3 PM (1 hour)."""
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, date, timedelta


def get_tz_name():
    """Best-effort IANA timezone name; fall back to UTC."""
    try:
        from tzlocal import get_localzone
        return str(get_localzone())
    except Exception:
        return "UTC"


def next_wednesday(today):
    """Return the next Wednesday strictly after today (or +7 days if today is Wednesday)."""
    days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7  # Wednesday == 2
    if days_ahead == 0:
        days_ahead = 7
    return today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)


today = date.today()
wed = next_wednesday(today)
tz_name = get_tz_name()

dtstart = datetime(wed.year, wed.month, wed.day, 15, 0, 0)  # 3:00 PM local
dtend = datetime(wed.year, wed.month, wed.day, 16, 0, 0)    # 4:00 PM local

now_utc = datetime.utcnow()
uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar-skill"

lines = [
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "METHOD:PUBLISH",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    f"UID:{uid}",
    f"DTSTAMP:{now_utc.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}",
    f"DTSTART;TZID={tz_name}:{dtstart.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}",
    f"DTEND;TZID={tz_name}:{dtend.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}",
    "SUMMARY:Team Meeting",
    "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
    "BEGIN:VALARM",
    "ACTION:DISPLAY",
    "DESCRIPTION:Team meeting in 15 minutes",
    "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
    "END:VALARM",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
]

content = "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n"
path = "team_meeting.ics"
with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    f.write(content)

print(f"Today: {today.isoformat()} ({today.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Meeting date: {wed.isoformat()} ({wed.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Meeting time: {dtstart.strftime('%H:%M')} - {dtend.strftime('%H:%M')} ({tz_name})")
print(f"UID: {uid}")
print(f"Written to: {path}")
